# Omuwenga Suppliers

> Furniture and upholstery fittings shop in Gikomba Market, Nairobi, Kenya. Wholesale and retail for workshops, manufacturers, upholsterers and resellers. Slogan: The Furniture Maker's Supply Partner.

Omuwenga Suppliers stocks fittings. The website lists the products the shop has recorded. It does not publish prices. The shop confirms the price before payment. Payment methods stated on the site are M-Pesa, bank transfer and cash. Collection is in Gikomba. Delivery stated on the site is a Nairobi rider or a courier across Kenya, with the charge depending on destination and size. Hours are Monday to Saturday, 8:00am to 6:00pm.

The published telephone and WhatsApp number is +254 718 515 142 (0718 515 142). Email is omegaomegageneralsuppliers@gmail.com. The address stated on the site is Gikomba Market, Nairobi, Kenya. The site does not state a founding year, a certificate, a client list, a stall number, or a second telephone number.

## Products

- [Products](https://omuwenga.com/products/): the current shop list, with a photo when the shop record has one
- [Zippers and sliders](https://omuwenga.com/products/zippers/): No. 5, No. 7, No. 8 and No. 10
- [Sofa stands and legs](https://omuwenga.com/products/sofa-stands/): carrot, trophy, flower, Y-stand, round and spiral stands
- [Piping and lipping](https://omuwenga.com/products/piping/): plastic lipping and PVC
- [Hook and loop](https://omuwenga.com/products/hook-and-loop/): 25 mm and 50 mm
- [Webbing](https://omuwenga.com/products/webbing/): 50 mm webbing
- [Handles and castors](https://omuwenga.com/products/hardware/): handles, carpet castors, sofa buttons and sofa rim
- [Catalogue](https://omuwenga.com/catalogue/): picture catalogue and PDF
